text: Retry the goal of 20261013-221358-r2d0 with a different approach; the verifier showed that text heuristics over criteria reject ordinary readings. Make the reading's deliverables list the single statement of file scope: (1) the reader prompt says scope is given only by the deliverables list and acceptance criteria never restate which files may change; (2) for change readings, code adds CHANGELOG.md to the deliverables when it is missing, with a 'changelog' default citing BRIEF.md's 'tagged releases and a changelog'; (3) the verifier's brief says a file outside the deliverables list is the scope finding, judged against the list, not against criterion wording. No text-matching of criteria. Stay within the reader's token budget without changing the meaning of existing prompt lines.
